title: An empty label drops its column under a solid rule or none
body: Without a dashed rule the reader takes each column's start from where its header words start (src/read.rs:223-230). A column with no label word leaves no start, so its cells join the column before it. Under a dashed rule this cannot happen. The writer does not check for it. Either the writer refuses an empty label without dashes, or the docs say so. The random tests in tests/read.rs:436-448 avoid the case.
